2a7a10d6-9cd5-41b3-bb1d-bcb1c1f73fd4.title: False Confession
2a7a10d6-9cd5-41b3-bb1d-bcb1c1f73fd4.description:
I confessed. I couldn't do it while sober so I took a shot of liquid courage.

"I like you."

"Why?"

"I just like everything about you."

"…I don't understand."

Something's strange. His voice is deeper, his height slightly different, and his physique even more so. In fact, after a closer look, even the hair colour that reflected the moonlight⁠—this is crazy. It’s someone else. It's none other than Duke Cabel Willard who's known as the 'Grim Reaper' of the battlefields.

"Cabel."

"… Excuse me?"

"From now on, don't refer to me by any strange titles. Call me by name instead."

The corners of his lips that were always frozen stiff curved into a smile. It seemed like he would immediately kill me if the truth of my false confession was brought to light.

---
"I think I’ve fallen for you." With a single drunken confession, Renesha's plans to live a comfortable and uneventful life were shattered. Somehow she confessed her love to the wrong man: the Grim Reaper of the Battlefield, Duke Cavert Willard! It's the worst thing to happen to her since she woke up in this fantasy universe and discovered her divine powers. In the midst of a war with a neighboring country, Renesha must balance her duties as a healer with her feelings for two alluring knights. When romance blooms on the battlefield, who will be victorious in the battle for Renesha's heart?

61889f95-60b7-4406-a5db-b256d2a742ae.title: Bungou Stray Dogs: Dazai wo Hirotta Hi
61889f95-60b7-4406-a5db-b256d2a742ae.altTitle: Bungou Stray Dogs: The Day I Picked Up Dazai
61889f95-60b7-4406-a5db-b256d2a742ae.description: One day, deliveryman Sakunosuke Oda finds a boy at his doorstep on the brink of death. His name is Osamu Dazai, and he is a member of the Port Mafia—the very embodiment of darkness and violence. Thus begins a peculiar living arrangement: Oda, who cares for the boy, and Dazai, who longs to die. But what will become of their newfound connection when a gang of former police officers known as the 48 attack them in search of a certain painting...?!

0139a824-a758-44f8-a841-2c247ebe4588.title: Seongja neun Gaeppul, Hyeondae Uihak ui Himida
0139a824-a758-44f8-a841-2c247ebe4588.altTitle: To Hell With Being a Saint, I'm a Doctor
0139a824-a758-44f8-a841-2c247ebe4588.description:
Jin Yoosung was a gifted surgeon said to be able to bring the dead back to life. However, not even this genius doctor had the ability to revive himself. Following a fatal car crash, Yoosung closed his eyes for what he'd thought was the last time… only to wake up and find that he's been reborn in a fantasy world!

A doctor through and through, Yoosung — now Ray — resolves to become a healer again. Unfortunately, it seems his new magical abilities may not be the most fitting for his dream career…

afe24df9-ba17-4f93-93ff-02e94cefd71f.title: Hoeguija ui Eunteoi Life
afe24df9-ba17-4f93-93ff-02e94cefd71f.description:
After two decades of battling extradimensional monsters and protecting the world, Lim Dae-in is finally ready to retire and enjoy a peaceful life. However, the morning after his retirement party, he wakes up to find himself back in time… before he even gained his powers. 

Armed with knowledge of the future, Dae-in is determined to secure his fortune and retire again, but this time within three years.

ee6ef096-7a92-4b5b-abb5-4879437473e7.title: Jimiko na Mitsuba-san ga Boku wo Yuuwaku Suru
ee6ef096-7a92-4b5b-abb5-4879437473e7.altTitle: The Plain Mitsuba-san is Tempting Me
ee6ef096-7a92-4b5b-abb5-4879437473e7.description:
The girl he thought was plain was actually a carnivore!!?

Takeshiro is an ordinary high school boy, and fter being rejected time and time again, he's become extremely careful not to mistake a girl's friendliness for romantic interest.. But even though he is such a stubborn boy, there is one girl he is very interested in. She is Mitsuba Akari, who sits next to him. She is plain and often forgotten by others, and is like an invisible mob girl who keeps coming on to him!! Takeshiro tries to suppress his instinct to fall in love, but he is at the mercy of Akari who keeps coming on to him!!?

Determined not to jump to conclusions and let himself fall in love over a misunderstanding, Takeshiro tries to keep his instincts in check. But Akari's increasingly direct approach keeps throwing him off balance...!

A romantic comedy about the plain, unassuming girl who's constantly making moves on me. A side of her only I get to see
